result: If I were to propose a single change to improve the world, it would be to enhance global access to education and information. By ensuring that everyone has the opportunity to learn and gain knowledge, we can empower individuals to make informed decisions, foster innovation, and promote understanding across different cultures and societies. This foundational change could lead to advancements in health, technology, social equity, and environmental sustainability, ultimately contributing to a more peaceful and prosperous world for all.
